summary: First-finish latency-sensitive testing complete. All 15 backend API checks and full frontend user journey (landing -> register -> chat mild + emergency -> sidebar -> logout -> protected route) passed. LLM (Claude Sonnet 5 via Emergent Universal Key) correctly returns follow-up questions for mild symptoms and emergency block with ⚠️ EMERGENCY heading for cardiac-style presentation; no OTC suggestions leaked into emergency reply. Cookies work cross-origin (SameSite=None; Secure).
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates user, sets httpOnly cookie, returns {id,email,name}
POST /api/auth/register duplicate email -> 400
POST /api/auth/logout returns 200
POST /api/auth/login with seeded admin (admin@medisense.app/admin123) -> 200 + cookie
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401
GET /api/auth/me returns 200 with cookie; 401 without
POST /api/chat mild sore throat -> follow-up questions in assistant_message (contains '?'), new conversation_id created
POST /api/chat with existing conversation_id continues same conversation and references prior context
POST /api/chat emergency prompt (chest pain + arm radiation + SOB) -> '⚠️ EMERGENCY' block present and NO OTC medication suggestions
GET /api/conversations returns list sorted by updated_at desc
GET /api/conversations/{id} returns messages in chronological order
DELETE /api/conversations/{id} -> 200; subsequent GET -> 404
Auth enforced on /api/chat and /api/conversations (401 without cookie)
Landing page renders hero-title, hero-start-btn, hero-how-btn, footer disclaimer
Register form redirects to /chat on success (nav-register-link -> register-form -> /chat)
Chat page shows welcome with 'MediSense', new-conversation-btn, chat-input, chat-send-btn
Sending mild symptom shows typing-indicator then assistant bubble
Emergency symptom renders red-bordered [data-testid='emergency-alert'] bubble
New conversation button clears chat area
Sidebar populates with conversations after chats
Logout redirects to landing and /chat becomes protected (redirects to /login)
